description: Source code for MojoCdmAllocator class implementing shared memory buffer management and video frame creation for media content decryption module (CDM) using Mojo IPC and shared memory.

classes.name: MojoCdmBuffer
classes.description: Implements cdm::Buffer interface, providing access to shared memory regions, with methods for destruction, data access, and size management.

classes.name: MojoCdmVideoFrame
classes.description: Creates VideoFrame objects from shared memory buffers, supporting transformation to media::VideoFrame.

methods.name: CreateCdmBuffer
methods.description: Creates or reuses a shared memory buffer of specified capacity.

methods.name: AllocateNewRegion
methods.description: Allocates a new shared memory region with padding and size constraints.

methods.name: AddRegionToAvailableMap
methods.description: Adds a shared memory region to the pool of available regions.

methods.name: GetRegionForTesting
methods.description: Returns the shared memory region associated with a buffer (testing purpose).

methods.name: GetAvailableRegionCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns the count of available shared memory regions (testing purpose).
